'''Niner''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]]<ref name="Order 66" /> [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]]<ref name="Guide" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Order 66" /> A [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Databank" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Order 66" /> [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Niner was created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="Databank" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> Niner [[Death/Legends|died]] at some point during the war, which spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> and they were mourned, along with the other deceased [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commando/Legends|commandos]], by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] training [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeants]] [[Kal Skirata]] and [[Walon Vau]]. The name "Niner," which was a name shared with many other clone commandos, was based on the clone's designation number.<ref name="Order 66" />

==Behind the scenes==
Niner was mentioned in the [[2009]] novel, ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="Order 66" />
